title: Chapter 32
text: ∫ one for the old boy he was just a cat cross-eyed, a dirty white with pale blue eyes I won’t bore you with his history just to say he had much bad luck and was a good old guy and he died like people die like elephants die like rats die like flowers die like water evaporates and the wind stops blowing the lungs gave out last Monday. now he’s in the rose garden and I’ve heard a stirring march playing for him inside of me which I know not many but some of you would like to know about. that’s all. Manx
